name: Live Oak Landscape & Hardscape LLC
summary: Landscape design, planting, patios, irrigation and lawn care for homes across Round Rock, Georgetown and north Austin.

steps.title: Walk the yard

groups.title: Landscape Design & Planting
groups.summary: Planting plans built around your yard's sun, shade and soil, then installed by our crew.
groups.intro: A good yard starts with what grows here. We walk the property, sketch a plan around how you use it and plant beds that look full in the first season and better in the third.
groups.imageAlt: A garden path between clipped hedges and flowering shrubs

services.title: Design Plans
services.text: A scaled drawing of beds, paths and plants, with a written price for each part.
points: Plant list chosen for sun and shade

services.title: Bed Installation
services.text: New beds dug, amended and planted, with steel edging and mulch to finish.

services.title: Tree Planting
services.text: Shade and ornamental trees set at the right depth and staked for the first year.

groups.title: Patios & Hardscapes
groups.summary: Flagstone and paver patios, walkways and low stone walls built on a compacted base.
groups.intro: Stone that stays level comes down to what is under it. Every patio and path we build sits on a compacted base, pitched so water runs away from the house.
groups.imageAlt: A backyard pool deck with pale stone paving and planted borders

services.title: Patios
services.text: Flagstone, travertine and paver patios sized for a table, a grill or a fire pit.

services.title: Walkways
services.text: Front walks and garden paths in stone, pavers or decomposed granite.

services.title: Retaining Walls
services.text: Low limestone and block walls that hold a slope and give beds a clean edge.

groups.title: Lawn Care
groups.summary: Weekly mowing, edging and seasonal care for St. Augustine and Bermuda lawns.
groups.intro: A steady schedule keeps a lawn thick enough to crowd out weeds. Our crews mow, edge and blow every visit, and treat the lawn on a seasonal plan.
groups.imageAlt: A freshly mowed lawn in close-up

services.title: Mowing and Edging
services.text: Weekly or every-other-week visits, cut at the right height for the season.

services.title: Sod Installation
services.text: Old turf removed, the ground graded and new sod laid and rolled.

groups.title: Irrigation & Drainage
groups.summary: Sprinkler repair, drip conversions and French drains by a licensed irrigator.
groups.intro: Most of a summer water bill is a system that waters the wrong places. We repair heads and leaks, convert beds to drip and drain the low spots that stay wet.
groups.imageAlt: A lush shaded garden with ferns and a low bed of flowers

services.title: Sprinkler Repair
services.text: Broken heads, leaking valves and controllers fixed and the zones reset.

services.title: Drip Conversions
services.text: Spray zones in beds switched to drip, which puts water at the roots.

services.title: French Drains
services.text: Gravel drains that carry standing water away from the house and the lawn.

about.title: A Round Rock crew that plants what it would plant at home.
text: Live Oak started in 2011 with one truck and a trailer of native plants. Most of our work still comes from neighbors who saw a yard we built and asked who did it.
Today the company designs, builds and maintains yards across Round Rock, Georgetown and north Austin, with the same crew leads who have been with us for years.
We would rather plant fewer things that thrive than fill a bed with plants that will not see August.
about.imageAlt: A trowel and fresh potting soil on a work table

reviews.author: Homeowner in Round Rock
reviews.text: They turned a bare backyard into a patio and beds we actually use. The estimate matched the final bill to the dollar.

reviews.author: Homeowner in Georgetown
reviews.text: Our sprinklers were watering the street. One visit, two broken heads and a reset controller, and the bill dropped the next month.

reviews.author: Homeowner in north Austin
reviews.text: The crew showed up when they said, kept the driveway clean and finished the walkway a day early.

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: No. We visit, measure and send a written estimate, free.
Most design and build jobs start two to four weeks after the estimate is approved.

faqs.q: Do you only do new installs?
faqs.a: No. We also take over lawn care and repair irrigation on yards we did not build.
